recommendation.description: Indicates whether a reminder should be scheduled ('schedule') or not ('ignore').

rationale.description: Detailed explanation of how the model arrived at the given recommendation.

actionable_language.description: Verbatim quotation of the actionable language detected in the message.

scheduling_trigger.description: Verbatim quotation of the scheduling trigger associated with the actionable language.

reminder_message.description: The task reminder text. IMPORTANT: If the original message contains text enclosed in quotes (single or double), use that quoted text verbatim as the reminder_message, including the quote marks. Do not summarize or shorten quoted text.

reminders.description: Array of reminders with relevant details. Empty if 'recommendation' is 'ignore'.
